requirements.statement: Publication views shall derive from verified internal claims through audience/classification policy, sanitization, unsupported-claim checks, rights checks, secret scanning, freshness review, and required approval.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Required publication classes shall include internal exhaustive, restricted engineering, controlled enterprise, public commercial, engineering quick reference, plain English, and machine-consumable.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Every derivative claim shall retain source claim ID, version/hash, truth state, allowed audience, sanitization policy, approval, freshness, and invalidation trigger.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability
